meta.name: apm-memory-retrieval-causal-graph
meta.authors: Joe + Claude team (futon3c), for encoding by Rob's causal engine
meta.purpose: Structural template of the deployed agent-memory system studied in retrieval-whitepaper-v2.md, authored for encoding as a WorkedCausalGraph. Grain is component-scale, per their compiler-model discipline: one variable per mechanism or state owner, mediators preserved, measurement layer separate from causal structure, time-indexed loop edges instead of cycles.
meta.format_note: Field names here are ours; adapt to WorkedCausalGraphSpec as needed. 'observes' edges are measurement-layer sensor attachments and must NOT be encoded as causal arrows. Arrow 'status' follows their evidence discipline: 'evidenced' arrows cite code or measurement; 'conjectured' arrows are the hypotheses V3 exists to test and should be encodable but flagged; no arrow rests on narrative plausibility alone.

variables.name: problem_state_t
variables.description: The target problem at its pre-dispatch revision: statement, sorry count, problem family. Reconstructible to any historical revision from git (staging H3d).
variables.values_note: For finite encoding: problem family (categorical) x sorry count (bounded int).

variables.name: corpus_state_t
variables.description: The reviewed memory corpus at dispatch time: memory entries, pattern attachments, graph topology. Currently a star-forest (V2 4.6): schema supports multi-attachment, only single attachments were ever written.
variables.values_note: Key summaries: entry count, attachment topology class {star_forest, populated_graph}, composition per era_regime.

variables.name: repo_state_t
variables.description: The apm-lean worktree: proved lemmas, ConstructionTargets modules, build stanzas. Owns the reachability axis (V2 5.1): a proved artifact is importable only if on the module path.
variables.values_note: Includes reachability of relevant lemmas {on_path, off_path, absent}.

variables.name: runner_lane
variables.description: Which runner model and lane attempts the dispatch (codex vs zai), plus session freshness. Confounded with receipt instrumentation until staging A3 ships (structured vs prose receipts).

variables.name: era_regime
variables.description: advice_era vs artifact_era. In advice_era (V2's frozen corpus) memories are prose advice with no importable referents; in artifact_era, Lean proofs and ConstructionTargets pointers are a main memory source. Affects the composition of corpus_state_t and its overlap with repo_state_t. Per Rob's Q4: model as separate regimes, never silently update V2's frozen-baseline claims.

variables.name: recall_enabled
variables.description: Whether the recall pipeline runs for this dispatch. THE COHORT'S INTERVENTION TARGET: randomized at dispatch over ~356 fresh problems, do(recall_enabled in {on, off}). Identifies the ITT of memory-system availability.

variables.name: withheld_ids
variables.description: Set of memory ids experimentally withheld; default empty. E2'S INTERVENTION TARGET: do(withheld_ids = {M}). Two candidate mechanisms with different edge targets: (a) removal from corpus_state_t (ship different database); (b) filter at surfaced_set (filter at dispatch). Their equivalence is requested receipt Q3.

variables.name: route_intent
variables.description: The proof route the runner is attempting AT QUERY TIME (Jensen-shaped vs Hoelder-shaped etc.). Explicit variable, not memory metadata, per Rob's reply. Determines query vocabulary (staging G6: 'the search vocabulary is determined by the proof you are trying to build'). Route revision across attempts is time-indexed inside the trajectory, not a cycle here.

variables.name: query_terms
variables.description: Query construction: dispatch packet to ~8 query terms via the 3-term/pairs/singles ladder. Implementation: dispatch_with_recall.clj. Sensor: S06 (planned, staging B5).
variables.values_note: DF band of terms {rare, mid, common}; ladder rung fired.

variables.name: lexical_candidates
variables.description: FTS5 candidate set: text-index matches for query_terms over the corpus index. The index has no temporal capability (staging B2), which is why sensor S07 must capture the seed at dispatch time.

variables.name: pattern_projection
variables.description: THE ATTACHMENT LAYER. Text matches reach pattern endpoints; surfaced memories are the patterns' reviewed attachments. C1 (the paper's central open conjecture) locates the emptiness bottleneck here: 'empty' means no MEMORIES surfaced, not no text matched. Three converging measurements, no direct test (V2 5.2).

variables.name: surfaced_set
variables.description: The offered set (ordered top-5) delivered to the runner: union of content-match arm (from V10) and pattern arm (from V11). E1 measured pattern-arm share at 44.97% on the attributed tail. Sensor S01 (reliable) records the offered ids; S02 records which arm delivered each.

variables.name: info_channel
variables.description: SUBSTITUTIVE channel: content from surfaced memories entering the runner's available information (facts, interface bridges, lemma names). The channel used_ids actually observes.

variables.name: policy_channel
variables.description: REGULATIVE channel: surfaced memories modifying the runner's policy - route preference, stopping rules, cautions, search bounds. Five of seven observed use-modes act here (V2 4.4); use rates 45-54% vs substitutive 15%. Structurally unobserved until B4 (sensor S05) exists. Per Rob: Memory -> Policy/Route/StoppingDecision -> Decision.

variables.name: repo_search
variables.description: The runner's direct repository/library search (grep, module browsing). A second information channel PARALLEL to recall: in the a96A04 natural experiment, repository grep found the unblocking lemma when recall had no entry for it (V2 5.1). Search vocabulary inherits from route_intent - the same route-relativity that binds recall.

variables.name: runner_trajectory
variables.description: The attempt sequence: decompositions tried, edits, searches, route revisions, stopping decisions. The phenomenon most memories act on (regulatively) and the node the adjudication rubric failed to have a category for (V2 4.4).

variables.name: lean_witness
variables.description: The Lean compiler's verdict on the trajectory's artifacts. The system's independent witness (V2 sect 2): outside the memory system, decision-keyed, cannot be contaminated by self-report.

variables.name: outcome
variables.description: Dispatch outcome: one-shot closure (cohort DV), final sorry count, attempts-to-close (E2 DV per its validated registration - on a solved panel closure has no variance, attempts do).

variables.name: corpus_state_t1
variables.description: corpus_state at t+1: harvest/scribe writes new memories and attachments from the trajectory and outcome. Time-indexed loop edge per their discipline (state[t] -> run -> state[t+1]); no cycle.

variables.name: repo_state_t1
variables.description: repo_state at t+1: commits from the trajectory (proofs landed, ConstructionTargets promoted). This edge is how 'the loop consumes its own experimental subjects' (staging H3d) enters the model formally.

arrows.mechanism: The pattern -> reviewed-attachment edges ARE corpus structure; on the current star-forest most patterns have few or no reviewed attachments (19 runner reports of a pattern surfacing with none behind it).

Content-match arm contributes direct text matches: 82 of 149 attributed surfacings.

Information shapes what the trajectory can attempt (per Rob: Memory -> AvailableInformation -> Decision).
Policy shapes how the trajectory proceeds (per Rob: Memory -> Policy -> Decision). Route revisions across attempts live here, time-indexed.

Compilation depends on what the repo makes importable (module path).

State carry-forward.
Trajectory commits proofs and promotes ConstructionTargets; this is the edge by which the loop consumed three of four E2 candidate problems (staging H3d).

arrows.mechanism: Artifact era adds ConstructionTargets modules and their reachability.

C1, THE CENTRAL CONJECTURE, as a claim about this edge's dominance: sparse attachments at V11 - not lexical failure at V09/V10 - generate the 64% empty-surfacing rate. Three converging measurements (80/90 empty candidate baselines; 62% of slots to never-used memories; 19 no-attachment reports), no direct test. E1's coverage back-fill is the test.

leak_edges.description: Backdoor paths that exist WITHOUT the E2 isolation surgery and are severed BY it. Encode as removable edges so the engine can verify identification with and without surgery. Every one is a path from post-solution knowledge into the trajectory that bypasses do(withheld_ids).

edges.mechanism: git log --all / git show from any historical checkout reaches the solved file; runners demonstrably search the repository.
edges.severed_by: history truncated at target revision (re-git-init from historical tree).

edges.from: futon3c lab artifacts describing routes and outcomes
edges.mechanism: Three lab files carry runner prose describing the winning routes for candidate problems.
A runner recalling its own prior exposure to the problem from its persistent store.
edges.severed_by: separate user account excludes ~/.codex by construction; residual: verify what a fresh agent inherits (staging H3g - NOT cleared).

edges.mechanism: K repeats sharing a session understate run-to-run variance; the same agent remembers earlier attempts.
edges.severed_by: fresh session per run, enforced as a typed guard (sessionId invariant, found at review pass 10).
edges.evidence: staging H3c item 2; H6 defect table.

measurement_layer.description: Sensors observe nodes; observes-edges are NOT causal arrows. Missingness per sensor must itself be modeled (Rob's requirement): every currently-populated sensor is a recency-biased tail, not a random sample, and absent values are not evidence of event absence. The Phase-0 repairs (strategy doc sect 2) are precisely: one sensor per unsensed node.

sensors.name: offered_receipts
sensors.missingness: effectively complete on offered halves; the one good sensor.

sensors.name: surfacing_via
sensors.observes: arm attribution of V10/V11 into V12
sensors.missingness: 30/129 dispatches; covers final 6.57% of corpus by elapsed time; onset-biased exactly where the interesting comparison (attachment accumulation) would start. Repair A4 extends to all paths.

sensors.name: used_ids
sensors.status: live, no code writer for outcome half
sensors.missingness: ~16% of outcome receipts; biased: dropped uses were 67% load-bearing vs 30% for kept (n=6, blind subset n=2). Wrong causal level for 5 of 7 use-modes. Repair A1 adds record-outcome! + backfill from ~130 job results on disk.

sensors.name: rejection_reasons
sensors.observes: decline reasoning at the V12-to-V16 interface
sensors.missingness: 7/129 non-empty; taxonomy recovered from runner prose at 66% coverage with directional undercount of topical mismatch.

sensors.name: memory_use_kind
sensors.missingness: does not exist; prerequisite for path-specific estimands and for lane-scoped retrieval (E4).

sensors.name: ladder_rung
sensors.missingness: does not exist; P1's H2 was untestable without it.

sensors.name: seed_capture
sensors.missingness: does not exist; without it no historical replay is possible, ever - the binding argument for instrument-before-dispatch.

sensors.name: runner_prose
sensors.missingness: near-complete narratively but lexically coded at 66% coverage; six uses appeared here that S03 dropped.

era.note: V2's frozen corpus is entirely advice_era. The prospective cohort runs entirely in artifact_era. Cross-regime comparisons are transport questions, not pooled estimates.

route.note: For route-relativity queries (C6/E5): does the effect of memory availability on outcome transport across route regimes? a95J08 is the characterized instance: three failed attempts under one route, first-try close under the other, with the unblocking lemma present in Mathlib throughout.

interventions.population: ~356 never-attempted problems, artifact_era, fully instrumented (S05-S07 shipped first)
interventions.primary_estimand: ITT of memory-system availability on one-shot closure (V18)
interventions.secondary_estimands: mediated effects through V13 vs V14 (needs S05); lane contrast by V04 (needs A3 to deconfound instrumentation); attempts-to-close

interventions.operation: do(withheld_ids = {M}) for M adjudicated load-bearing vs incidental, on closed problems re-run from pre-solution state
interventions.population: 4 staged problems at pre-solution revisions under apmablate isolation (L1-L4 severed)
interventions.primary_estimand: ITT of single-memory availability on closure/attempts (Rob's Q2 correction)
interventions.purpose: H1 design: validates whether the load-bearing adjudication rubric tracks interventional effects at all - tests our instrument, not just the memory

requested_receipts.question: What does I_cohort identify? Confirm the randomization of V06 identifies the total effect on V18 without adjustment; state what additional conditioning (if any) the lane-subgroup contrast (V04) and problem-family subgroups require; flag any backdoor we have missed.
requested_receipts.expected_shape: identification receipt with adjustment sets (expected: empty set for the primary) + any refusals.

requested_receipts.question: What does I_E2 identify, given the isolation surgery? Verify identification of the availability effect requires severing L1-L4 (i.e., exhibit the backdoor paths each leak edge opens when present); state the mediation decomposition through V13 vs V14 that becomes identifiable once sensor S05 exists, and what remains unidentifiable without it.
requested_receipts.expected_shape: identification with surgery-conditional validity + NDE/NIE preconditions per their effect algebra.

requested_receipts.question: Filter-equivalence d-separation: is V18 independent of membership of M in V02, given the realized V12 (surfaced set)? Run on BOTH corpus topologies: star_forest (current) and populated_graph (post multi-attachment repair). Our prediction: holds on star_forest (so E2 mechanism (b) filter-at-dispatch is a valid cheap substitute for (a) ship-different-databases), and FAILS on populated_graph (removing M then changes what else surfaces through shared patterns, so (a) and (b) diverge). A confirmed divergence is itself a finding about the graph-population repair and would be preregistered as such.
requested_receipts.expected_shape: two d-separation receipts, one per topology, with the separating/connecting paths named.

out_of_scope_v1: The goal-level conative graph (queue blocking relations, :blocked-on/:unblocks). Per Rob's Q1 these are dependency relations that become causal arrows only when interventions on blockers have defined downstream consequences - deferred to v2 of this spec after one such intervention is characterized.
Statistical estimation and the missingness weighting model - stays on our side (integration doc sect 6.5); this spec carries only measurement-layer structure.
Duplicate-detection / write-side identity (C8/E7) - separate small graph if useful later.
